findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: vertodigital_get_site_index, vertodigital_get_page, vertodigital_search_case_studies, vertodigital_get_contact · Private data: vertodigital_get_page, vertodigital_get_contact, vertodigital_send_enquiry · Public sink: vertodigital_get_site_index, vertodigital_get_contact, vertodigital_send_enquiry · Destructive: vertodigital_get_page, vertodigital_get_contact.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: vertodigital_get_site_index, vertodigital_get_page, vertodigital_search_case_studies, vertodigital_get_contact · Private data: vertodigital_get_page, vertodigital_get_contact, vertodigital_send_enquiry · Public sink: vertodigital_get_site_index, vertodigital_get_contact, vertodigital_send_enquiry · Destructive: vertodigital_get_page, vertodigital_get_contact

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
